title: Geometric Derivation of B_A = sqrt(3)/2

path1_equilateral_simplex.note: C_0 = sqrt(6)/(2*pi) is the composition at Pe=0 on the equilateral line. This is a clean algebraic expression combining the simplex geometry (sqrt(6)) with the Fisher-Rao geodesic (pi). However, Path 1 does not produce B_A = sqrt(3)/2 from first principles -- it merely describes what B_A = sqrt(3)/2 implies.

path2_fisher_3simplex.derivation: B_A = cos(theta/2) where theta = arccos(1/2) = pi/3 is the center-to-vertex Fisher angle on 3-simplex
path2_fisher_3simplex.note: B_A = cos(pi/6) where pi/6 is HALF the center-to-vertex Fisher geodesic angle on the 3-simplex. The 3-simplex arises because 3 behavioral dimensions create a 4-outcome (3+1) categorical model. The center-to-vertex angle on the n-simplex Fisher sphere is arccos(1/sqrt(n+1)); for n=3, this is pi/3. B_A = cos(pi/6) = cos((pi/3)/2) = sqrt(3)/2. This connects B_A to the Fisher-Rao geometry of the behavioral composition space.

path3_cencov_connection.note: If B_A = L'/sqrt(2), then L' = sqrt(6)/2. This is not a standard geodesic length on common statistical manifolds. The Cencov-type derivation L'/sqrt(2) does not naturally produce sqrt(3)/2. However, Path 2 already showed B_A = cos(pi/6) from Fisher geometry -- the forms differ (cos(angle) vs length/sqrt(2)) because B_A and B_G encode different geometric features of their respective information manifolds.

path4_critical_point.note: The inflection point is at Pe=0 (C_0 = B_A/B_G) by construction of sinh. No additional constraint on B_A emerges from critical point analysis alone. The inflection IS the zero, which is tautological for odd functions.

path5_maximum_entropy.note: Min-Fisher gives C=1/2, which gives B_A = B_G/2 = pi/(2*sqrt(2)) = 1.111, not sqrt(3)/2. Max-entropy gives C=1/4. The equilateral Pe=0 point (C=0.39) lies outside the probability simplex constraint. No entropy/Fisher optimization on the equilateral line produces B_A = sqrt(3)/2.

successful_derivation.geometric_meaning: B_A is the cosine of half the Fisher-Rao geodesic angle from the uniform (maximum-entropy) state to a pure (vertex) state on the 3-simplex of behavioral compositions.
